free-tier-limits: The free tier allows 60 requests per minute and 10,000 requests per day [rate-limits].
limit-exceeded: When a limit is exceeded the API returns HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header [rate-limits].
key-rotation: Keys can be rotated at any time from the dashboard, and the previous key keeps working for 24 hours after rotation [auth].
batch-endpoints: Keys created on the free tier cannot call the batch endpoints [auth].
